capstones.name: Final Stand Discipline
capstones.effect: For 30 rounds, take 45% less melee damage. Cannot be stunned from the front.
capstones.description: The warrior plants their feet and becomes the wall. Nothing passes.

capstones.name: Divine Intervention
capstones.effect: Buff target (or self). The next time they would die within 50 rounds, they are instead healed to 50% HP. One-time trigger.
capstones.description: The gods themselves intervene. Death is not today.

mechanics.notes: Target or self. One-time: next would-be death within duration heals to 50% HP instead.

capstones.name: Harm Touch
capstones.effect: Instant direct damage to target: 500 + (level × 10) as unresistable magic damage. Cannot miss.
capstones.description: The shadowknight channels pure hatred into a single devastating touch.

capstones.name: Speed Focus Discipline
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, attack speed +50%, fist damage +25%. Cannot be interrupted.
capstones.description: The monk enters a state of perfect martial focus. Fists become a blur.

capstones.name: Frenzied Stabbing Discipline
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, backstab cooldown reduced by 50%, backstab damage +30%.
capstones.description: The rogue abandons caution for pure killing speed.

capstones.name: Blood Pact
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, melee damage +40%, but take 10% of damage dealt as recoil. Requires <90% HP to activate.
capstones.description: The berserker offers their own blood for greater fury.

capstones.name: Headshot
capstones.effect: Passive: Bow attacks gain 5% chance to instantly kill humanoid targets below 20% HP.
capstones.description: The ranger's arrow finds the perfect killing shot.

mechanics.description: Headshot: bow attacks gain 5% chance to instantly kill humanoid targets below 20% HP.

capstones.name: Bestial Alignment
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, beastlord and warder both gain +30% melee damage, +20% attack speed.
capstones.description: Beast and master fight as one primal force.

capstones.name: Fierce Eye
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, group gains +25% crit chance, +15% proc rate, +10% accuracy.
capstones.description: The bard's fierce gaze inspires the group to legendary feats.

capstones.name: Celestial Cleansing
capstones.effect: Instantly cure all detrimental effects (poison, disease, curse, magic) on the group. Heal for 200 per effect removed.
capstones.description: Divine light scours away all affliction.

mechanics.notes: Heal 200 per effect removed — heal author.

capstones.name: Spirit of the Wood
capstones.effect: Group buff (100 rounds): +50 HP/tick regen, +20 mana/tick, +15 attack.
capstones.description: The druid calls on the ancient spirits of the forest.

capstones.name: Torpor
capstones.effect: Target: 70% slow for 20 rounds + 100 HP/tick heal-over-time. Cannot be cast on self while moving.
capstones.description: The shaman's most potent medicine — stillness and mending.

mechanics.notes: HYBRID: also grants 100 HP/tick HoT to target — heal author should add heal component.

capstones.name: Beguiler's Synergy
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, whenever the enchanter casts a mez or stun, the group gains +15% spell damage for 5 rounds.
capstones.description: The enchanter's control magic empowers allies' destruction.

capstones.name: Host of the Elements
capstones.effect: Summon 4 elemental swarm pets (earth, air, fire, water) for 10 rounds. Each deals moderate damage.
capstones.description: The magician calls a host of elementals to overwhelm the enemy.

mechanics.description: Summons 4 elemental swarm pets (earth, air, fire, water) for 1 minute. Each deals moderate damage.

capstones.name: Life Burn
capstones.effect: Convert 50% of current HP into direct damage to target (unresistable). Cannot kill the caster.
capstones.description: The necromancer burns their own life force as a weapon.

mechanics.notes: Converts 50% of current HP into damage. Cannot kill the caster (caster keeps at least 1 HP).

capstones.name: Manaburn
capstones.effect: Convert 100% of current mana into direct damage to target (unresistable, 2:1 ratio). Caster is left at 0 mana.
capstones.description: The wizard's ultimate sacrifice — all mana, one apocalyptic strike.

mechanics.notes: Converts 100% of current mana into damage at a 2:1 ratio. Caster is left at 0 mana.
